title: Elux Firerose 5000 Blackcurrant Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blackcurrant Lemonade from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection combines the deep, rich taste of blackcurrants with the zesty and refreshing notes of lemonade. This e-liquid offers a vibrant and tangy fruit blend, perfect for those who enjoy a bold and fruity flavour profile. The sharp taste of the blackcurrant flavour is deftly balanced by the citrusy lemonade undertones, creating a satisfying and refreshing vaping experience. The interplay of juicy blackcurrants and tangy lemonade delivers a vape that’s both sweet and sharp and endlessly satisfying. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
